scope: Every armed CR vehicle/building ODF; people use weapon presentation; armories are suppliers.
casing_port_status: Per-slot fitted offsets/directions authored for the weapon-rig models; companion OpenShim runtime required.

abtowe.action: Use agn11bgb: 38 vertices / 34 triangles, rigid weight 1.0, native node and static local translation. GC1 is its child. No geometry split needed; tune short tip travel. Preserve ty1/tx1 aim parents.

avartl.action: Four separate aar11bgd/bgc/bgb/bga barrels for GM1/2/3/4. Bind each fired slot independently. Preserve deployed pose and aiming; mortar weapons need an explicit kick because existing CR kicks are CANN-category only.

avfigh.action: Closed gun sections and EXU world/cockpit clips authored; 0 channels contain cockpit gun geometry. Original drivers, source UVs and closed receiver caps retained. Outboard casing ports are ray-fitted clear of the world hull; requires companion OpenShim spin/port support. Native visual qualification remains pending.

avhraz.action: Two independent top-gun meshes: ahr11bga / ahr11bgb, each 500 vertices / 636 triangles, weight 1.0 and static native node. Default GR1/GR2 markers are under ahr11rof, but their positions lie inside the corresponding left/right barrel bounds. Bind slot 2 to bga, slot 3 to bgb explicitly; both grktbomb slots need craft recoilKick overrides. No geometry split is needed to move the whole existing top-gun pieces. A tip-only telescoping action would require subdivision/reweighting. Do not recoil the roof.

avland.action: The armed lander marker is attached to lla11bda. Identify/select the visible muzzle/emitter and give it a gun-only child; preserve the large landing structure. No ready dedicated cannon-tip node found.

avltnk.action: Closed gun sections and EXU world/cockpit clips authored; 1 channels contain cockpit gun geometry. Original drivers, source UVs and closed receiver caps retained. Outboard casing ports are ray-fitted clear of the world hull; requires companion OpenShim spin/port support. Native visual qualification remains pending.

avmine.action: Equipped slots deploy mines/support/utility objects. No firearm barrel recoil required. An optional deployment animation is a separate behavior and must not be triggered as cannon recoil.

avtank.action: Existing AGR11BGA cannon binding. Secondary gun is on AGR11BDA and needs gun-only weighting if physical secondary recoil is wanted; do not slide the hull.

avturr.action: Independent barrel tubes aDE11blc/bld/ble/blf, each 116 vertices / 190 triangles. GC1 uses blc; GC2 uses blf. These names are not BG*, so the old heuristic missed them. Miniguns require a craft kick override.
